description: Three VCOs on one panel, each with its own pitch offsets, waveform and mixing level, with separate outputs and a mixed output, and hard sync from VCO 1 to either of the others

params.text: Sets how much of that VCO goes into the mixed output, with no effect on that VCO's own output jack
Sets the base octave for that VCO over a ten octave range, with the number shown above the knob
Transposes that VCO by up to 12 semitones either way, shown as a note name while its V/oct jack is patched and as the interval from the VCO it tracks while it is not
Tunes that VCO a semitone up or down
Attenuates the CV at the Fm jack for that VCO, which bends the pitch exponentially and suits vibrato rather than FM synthesis
Picks the waveform for that VCO: sine, triangle, saw, square, even, or off, which silences it without unpatching anything
Sets the pulse width for that VCO, with an audible effect only while its square wave is selected
Attenuates the CV at the Pwm jack for that VCO before it is added to the pulse width knob
Hard-syncs that VCO to VCO 1, restarting its cycle from the saw wave of VCO 1

inputs.text: Sets the pitch of that VCO, a volt per octave; left unpatched, the VCO takes its pitch from the nearest patched V/oct jack above it
Bends the pitch of that VCO through its Mod knob; left unpatched, it takes the signal from the nearest patched Fm jack above it
Modulates the pulse width of that VCO through its pwm knob; left unpatched, it takes the signal from the nearest patched Pwm jack above it

outputs.text: The three VCOs added together at the levels set by the mixing knobs, scaled back to a 10V peak when those levels total more than full scale; the plus signs turn green while that is happening
That VCO's waveform on its own, at full level, untouched by the mixing knobs

notes: the three mixing knobs come up at zero, so the mixed output is silent until one of them is turned up; each VCO's own output jack carries full level from the start
the Mod and Pwm knobs come up at zero, so a cable at a Fm or Pwm jack changes nothing until the knob for that VCO is turned up

inputs.0: 1V per octave · continuous · one channel only
inputs.1: 1V per octave · continuous · one channel only
inputs.2: 1V per octave · continuous · one channel only
